adapter_validation.scope: Adapter scale/mask/layout check; full native correctness is not inferred from this test.

scope.purpose: Quantify full-model consequence of native TriAttention TF32 precision path; original frozen four modes remain separately identifiable.
scope.gpu_policy: PPU workers on physical 0 and 7; H100 workers on physical 0 and 7; no shared physical GPU among our jobs.

new_policies.tf32_triangle_ieee: H100 native CUE IEEE only inside TriAttention, other matmul remains TF32; mixed precision diagnostic.
new_policies.tf32_triangle_corrected: Custom H100 CUDA RNE-once TriAttention adapted to native layout; entire attention implementation changes, so not a query-only ablation and not native CUE.
new_policies.confidence_head_ieee: Six H100 diagnostic cases: disable global matmul TF32 only in ConfidenceHead forward by class; custom triangle explicitly remains TF32. Not a promoted PPU policy.

scope.training: No new training claim in this inference-focused round; previous backward-only full-training evidence retained separately.
scope.data: Raw weights, activations, coordinates and gradients remain on their original server; aggregate scalar/hash reports only.
scope.adapter_control_failure: Initial adapter returned four dimensions for 4D Q inputs although native low-level CUE retains five dimensions. Real caller [0] removed N instead of B. Initial corrected-mode model outputs and timings discarded; exact native rank assertion added; corrected models rerun.
scope.precision_intent: No PPU workaround that imitates measured native query drift; native and corrected diagnostics remain separate.

precision_audit.scope: Global matmul TF32 disabled only during ConfidenceHead forward. Custom corrected TriAttention retains explicit TF32 RNE. No model or shape whitelist.

limits: Initial corrected model results were discarded because the adapter squeezed the native five-dimensional output. Fixed rank-contract tests and all 18 corrected model runs replace those results.
The IEEE counterfactual changes only native triangle precision; the corrected counterfactual changes the complete triangle kernel, not just query rounding.
Counterfactual H100 results are separately labeled and do not replace the frozen native acceptance reference.
Cross-device RMSDs are rigorous intervals from frozen anchors, not newly measured exact cross-server coordinate distances.
One cycle/step/sample, 1 warmup/3 repeats per mode. No full sampling, new training, MFU or 80% target acceptance claim.
PPU FP32/TF32 kernels were not changed in this round; fresh timings do not establish a PPU optimization gain.
